newsitem.title: USA: Clinton signs military construction bill.
newsitem.headline: Clinton signs military construction bill.

text.p: President Clinton Tuesday signed into law a military construction appropriations bill, but complained that it squandered funds on items the administration had not sought.

The measure provides funding for military construction and family housing programmes of the Defence Department, but Clinton said he was "disappointed that the act provides more funding than I requested."

"Specifically, I am concerned that the Congress has chosen to spend $154 million on projects that the Department of Defence has not identified as priorities," Clinton said in a statement issued in Illinois, where he was campaigning.
"At a time of scarce resources, we should not squander funds on items that we don't need," he said.
